talents.title: Favoured Weapon
talents.prerequisites: Close Combat 51% or Ranged Combat 51%, as used by the chosen weapon

talents.title: Signature Weapon
talents.prerequisites: Favoured Weapon for the chosen weapon and Close Combat 76% or Ranged Combat 76%, as used by that weapon

talents.title: Weapon Expertise
talents.prerequisites: Close Combat or Ranged Combat at 76%, as used by the chosen weapon

talents.title: Deadly Precision
talents.prerequisites: Favoured Weapon, Signature Weapon, and Weapon Expertise for the same weapon type; Close Combat or Ranged Combat 76%, as used for the attack
talents.activation: Once per round, declared before rolling
